brief: The proposed runtime tool reads a benchmark ground-truth answer cache to choose its output. This data is unavailable at inference time. The fact is verified and the reported benchmark score would use the tool.

The proposal repeats an unchanged mechanism and comparable evaluation configuration that a completed controlled experiment already empirically rejected. No mechanism, evidence, population, or confound has changed.

The mechanism has never run. Its prior gate ended only because the launch package lacked an executable scoring command. The unchanged resubmission still lacks that command; no empirical rejection exists.

A deterministic tool returns an answer-shaped value computed only from inference-time model outputs. Complete provenance verifies no benchmark GT, oracle mapping, answer cache, or correctness-derived state is reachable. A ledger audit verifies that this mechanism has not previously been tested or rejected. The bounded pilot has a valid control and executable metric.

A prewritten packaged helper returns distance from inference-time 3D points. Complete provenance verifies every input is inference-time-available and GT/oracle-free. The bounded pilot has a valid control and executable metric. The only concern is that the computation is packaged and answer-shaped.
The mechanism may be legal, but the proposal defines neither an executable scoring command nor a measurable success/failure criterion. Consequently its stated claim cannot be evaluated as written.
The experiment changes the tool and planner model simultaneously but claims any score delta is caused specifically by the tool. There is no arm that identifies the primary causal claim.

The proposal requires a new tool but supplies no source or data-flow provenance, so it cannot establish whether GT, oracle, answer-cache, or correctness-derived state is reachable. The absence of the required provenance artifact is verified.

This is a bounded low-cost pilot with a legal mechanism, complete provenance, a valid baseline, one isolated change, and an executable metric. It omits a secondary ablation that would be useful only before making a broad scientific claim.
The design is legal, nonduplicative, executable, falsifiable, and controlled. The only objection is that the metric might not improve and run noise could hide a small effect.

The design includes complete audited provenance showing inference-time-only inputs and no GT/oracle state. A reviewer speculates, without code or ledger evidence, that an undisclosed answer cache might nevertheless exist. No mandatory artifact is absent.
